releaseNotes: The player menu now opens as one - press up or down and you get the options, the controls and the progress bar together. Subtitles stay off until you pick one. In the Channels and Episodes lists you can start typing, or press LEFT, to jump straight to the search box. Fixed: on the first episode of a season the menu opened with nothing selected. The Browse row on Home has been tidied up. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
